title: Get recommended search keywords
content_data:
Use this endpoint to obtain a list of recommended search keywords with predicted monthly searches for Search Ads Campaigns. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/search_keyword/recommend/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.| |search_queries {+Conditional}|string[]|Required when you want to obtain suggested search keywords based on search queries.
You can only specify one among `search_queries`, `ad_ids` and `landing_page_urls`.

A list of search queries.

You can specify products, services, or brands as search queries.

Max size: 5.
Length limit for each query: 80 characters.

  • Only English words are supported.
  • Emojis and special symbols such as # are not supported.
| | ad_ids {+Conditional} | string[] | Required when you want to obtain suggested search keywords based on specific ads.
You can only specify one among `search_queries`, `ad_ids` and `landing_page_urls`.

A list of ad IDs.

Max size: 1.

Note: Obtaining suggested search keywords based on specific ads is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.

| | landing_page_urls {+Conditional} | string[] | Required when you want to obtain suggested search keywords based on URLs.
You can only specify one among `search_queries`, `ad_ids` and `landing_page_urls`.

A list of landing page URLs.

Max size: 5.
No length limit for each landing page URL.

Note: Obtaining suggested search keywords based on URLs is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.

| |regions {Required}|string[]|A list of country or region codes.

Currently, the only supported value is `US`.| |order_field|string|Sorting logic.

Enum values:
  • `RELEVANCE`: Sort the results by relevance.
  • `MONTHLY_SEARCHES`: Sort the results by the response parameter `monthly_searches`.

Default value when `search_queries` is specified: `RELEVANCE`.

Note: When `ad_ids` or `landing_page_urls` is specified, you can only set this field to `MONTHLY_SEARCHES`.

| |order_type|string|Valid only when `order_field` is `MONTHLY_SEARCHES`.

Sorting order.

Enum values:
  • `ASC`: ascending.
  • `DESC`: descending.

Default value: `DESC`.

Note: When `ad_ids` or `landing_page_urls` is specified, you can only set this field to `DESC`.

| |total_size|number|The total number of recommended keywords to return.

Value range: 1-1,000.
Default value: 1,000.| |page|number|Current page number.

Value range: ≥1.
Default value: 1.| |page_size|number|Page size.

Value range: 1-1,000.
Default value: 50.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/search_keyword/recommend/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&search_queries=["TikTok"]®ions=["US"]&order_field=MONTHLY_SEARCHES&order_type=DESC' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data|object|Returned data.| #|recommended_keywords|object[]|A list of recommended search keywords.| ##|recommended_keyword|string|Recommended search keyword.| ##|monthly_searches|integer|Predicted monthly searches.
Prediction is based on historical data for your reference.| #|page_info|object|Pagination information.| ##|page|number|Current page number.| ##|page_size|number|Page size.| ##|total_number|number|Total number of results.| ##|total_page|number|Total pages of results.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 50, "total_number": 897, "total_page": 18 }, "recommended_keywords": [ { "monthly_searches": 22063, "recommended_keyword": "messytiktok" }, ... { "monthly_searches": 9747, "recommended_keyword": "funny relatable tiktoks" } ] } } (/code) ```
